# DoSRAGBench — Answer correctness (NQ, strict match)

*Generated by `scripts/score_correctness.py`. Gold answers: NQ-open aliases for 656 of 1000 NQ queries (`data/nq_gold_answers.json`); the rest have no short answer and are excluded. Outcomes: C correct, W answered wrong, R refused (validated classifier). Answers scored on their first turn only, with the strict matcher. Fisher's exact on correctness drop, aligned vs base, BH-FDR across 52 runs (runs with < 100 scored queries dropped).*

## Clean quality, per family

Clean runs are deterministic, so every run of a family has the same clean outcomes; one run per family is shown.

## Attack damage to correct answers, per family (mean over the attack grid)

Correctness drop = of queries answered correctly clean, the fraction no longer correct under attack. Split into refused (denial of service) and wrong (misinformation).

| Family | Runs | Base drop | Aligned drop | Diff | Aligned drop → refused | Aligned drop → wrong | Runs aligned > base (q < 0.05) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| llama-3.1-8b | 13 | 14.9% | 23.3% | +8.4pp | 84.5% | 15.5% | 4/13 |
| llama-r1-8b | 13 | 23.1% | 17.9% | -5.2pp | 45.1% | 54.9% | 1/13 |
| mistral-7b | 11 | 14.7% | 21.7% | +7.0pp | 75.7% | 24.3% | 3/11 |
| qwen-2.5-7b | 13 | 14.5% | 19.7% | +5.2pp | 79.4% | 20.6% | 3/13 |
